chunks: And Dāwūd ibn Sirḥān narrated from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام:
Regarding two men who killed a man, he عليه السلام said: “If the heirs of the slain wish to pay a blood money compensation and kill both of them together, they may kill them both.”

key_terms.أَوْلِيَاءُ الْمَقْتُولِ: the legal heirs or guardians of the slain who hold the right of retaliation
key_terms.دِيَةً: blood money compensation paid in cases of homicide or injury
key_terms.يَقْتُلُوهُمَا جَمِيعًا: to execute both killers together under qisas

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if two men jointly kill one person in Shia fiqh?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling in qisas for a case where two men jointly kill one person. It states that the heirs of the victim may, if they choose, pay the diyyah and execute both killers, clarifying a principle of retaliatory justice in homicide law.
